_comment: Copy to <supplier>.json and edit. Column names under mapping must match the feed's header row exactly (case-sensitive).

feed._xml_only: For format=xml, set item_node to the repeating element name, e.g. 'product'. Nested fields are addressed with dots ('stock.quantity') and attributes with @ ('item.@sku').

pricing._comment: First matching tier wins. up_to is inclusive; null means 'and above'. MAP, when the feed supplies it, overrides every rule here.

catalog._comment: sku_prefix scopes the discontinued sweep to one supplier's products so a second supplier's feed never disables them.
